fd0ab0b7e57969128fbd475865ba227f0ea25c0d.QuestDescription: During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. Place it at his statue, and then return to me.  I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Uther his tribute.
